description: This file contains implementation of big number arithmetic functions used in cryptographic operations, including multiplication, addition, squaring, and division of large integers, with conditional compilation for different architecture specifics.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies each word of a big number by a scalar and adds the result to a running total, handling multiple words and architecture-specific optimizations.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Performs large number multiplication of two big numbers with a scalar, optimized for specific architectures, returning the carry.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares a big number, processing multiple words at a time, optimized for architecture.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Performs division of a large number represented by high and low parts by a scalar, returning the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two large numbers (also as arrays of words), returning the carry, with different implementations depending on whether BN_LLONG is defined.

ctags.name: bn_div_words
ctags.pattern: /^BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h, BN_ULONG l, BN_ULONG d)$/

ctags.name: bn_mul_add_words
ctags.pattern: /^BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG *rp, BN_ULONG *ap, int num, BN_ULONG w)$/

ctags.name: bn_mul_words
ctags.pattern: /^BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG *rp, BN_ULONG *ap, int num, BN_ULONG w)$/
